decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period)
fact: Causing a collision Infringment Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Hulkenberg caused a collision on the inside of Turn 6 on the first lap. The Stewards considered that as he dove in and was unable to control the car and was not forced there by any other car this does not get the benefit of the doubt of a first lap incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Infringement Car 27 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
